help.text:
Usage: nemotron [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...                                    
                                                                                
 Nemotron CLI - Reproducible training recipes                                   
                                                                                
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --config              -c      <str>  Config name (looks in recipe's config/  │
│                                      dir) or path                            │
│ --run                 -r      <str>  Execute attached via nemo-run with      │
│                                      specified env profile                   │
│ --batch               -b      <str>  Execute detached via nemo-run with      │
│                                      specified env profile                   │
│ --dry-run             -d             Print compiled config as rich table (no │
│                                      execution)                              │
│ --stage                              Stage script + config to remote cluster │
│                                      for interactive debugging               │
│ --force-squash                       Force re-squash container image even if │
│                                      it already exists                       │
│ --install-completion                 Install completion for the current      │
│                                      shell.                                  │
│ --show-completion                    Show completion for the current shell,  │
│                                      to copy it or customize the             │
│                                      installation.                           │
│ --help                -h             Show this message and exit.             │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Commands ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ ultra3  Ultra3 training recipe                                               │
│ kit     Utility commands for cluster setup and management                    │
│ steps   Discover, inspect, run, and compose agentic workflow steps.          │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

--api-key.help: NVIDIA API key (or set NVIDIA_API_KEY environment variable).

--bands-per-iteration.help: Number of LSH bands to shuffle concurrently. Higher values are faster but use more memory.

--base-url.help: Base URL for the LLM API endpoint.

--bytes-per-token.help: If using a tokenizer, specify how many bytes each token uses so that removals only remove whole tokens

--cache-dir.help: Cache directory for intermediate files. Layout: cache_dir/cc_downloads (WARC files), cache_dir/model (FastText model), plus results.pkl and metrics.json.

--classify.help: Run the classification phase: filter to English and score with 3 quality classifiers.

--config.help: Path to the YAML config file

--config-file.help: Path to the YAML OmegaConf override file. Default: conf/llama3_8b_pretrain_override_example.yaml

--dedup-command.help: Path to dedup_dataset binary from deduplicate-text-datasets repository

--ensemble.help: Run the ensemble phase: compute thresholds, map to int bins, and write bucketed output.

--file-limit.help: Maximum number of input files to process

--identification-batchsize.help: Number of partitions to process per identification batch.

--identify.help: Run the identification phase to find exact duplicates.

--input-blocksize.help: Target partition size for input data (e.g., '256MiB', '512MiB', '2GiB').

--input-dir.help: Directory containing the input dataset (output of step 1).

--languages.help: Language codes to keep (e.g., EN DE FR). If omitted, all languages are written.

--length-threshold.help: Minimum length for intervals to remove

--max-concurrent-requests.help: Maximum number of concurrent API requests.

--max-retries.help: Maximum number of retries for failed requests.

--max-tokens.help: Maximum tokens to generate per sample (overrides per-task defaults).

--model-name.help: Name of the model to use for generation.

--num-cpus.help: Number of CPUs for the Ray cluster (default: all available).

--num-gpus.help: Number of GPUs for a local Ray cluster (default: all available). Ignored when connecting to an external cluster.

--original-dataset-path.help: Path to the original JSONL dataset

--output-dir.help: Directory to write the preprocessed extracted content.

--output-filetype.help: Format of the deduplicated output files.

--output-path.help: Path to output dataset.bin.part.x-xx, dataset.bin.part.x-xx.table.bin, and dataset.bin.table.bin files

--record-limit.help: Limit number of records to extract per WARC file (useful for testing).

--remove.help: Run the removal phase to remove identified duplicates.

--rmm-pool-size.help: Size of the RMM GPU memory pool in bytes, 'auto' for 90%% of free GPU memory, or 'none'.

--spill-memory-limit.help: Device memory limit in bytes for spilling to host, 'auto' for 80%% of RMM pool, or 'none'.

--storage-options.help: JSON string of fsspec storage options for cloud output paths (e.g., '{"key": "...", "secret": "..."}').

--task.help: SDG task to run. Use 'all' to run all four tasks sequentially.

--text-field.help: Name of the field containing the document text.

--threshold-sample-frac.help: Fraction of rows to sample per file when computing percentile thresholds. Use < 1.0 (e.g. 0.01) to reduce memory at large scale.

--timeout.help: Timeout in seconds for each LLM API request.

--total-nparts.help: Total number of output partitions for identification. Auto-determined if not set.

--url-limit.help: Limit number of WARC files to download per snapshot (useful for testing).
